title: out of date spam flagging
body: A flag message with the message "Mr. President A Second Plane Has Hit The Boom(aur)er https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XJWqHmY-g9U https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=072Nu54avdU" has been flooding many packages as of today, some of the affected packages i've seen: lib32-nvidia-580xx-utils nvidia-580xx-utils nvidia-580xx-dkms paru paru-git there's more... accounts flagging packages: vjzzpvy0493n ybnmaob2594j ...
